standard: Rolling bearing catalog records: boundary dimensions, load ratings and attainable speeds as published by the maker for the exact designation; ISO 15 boundary dimensions

708 CE/HCP4A.type: super-precision angular contact ball bearing, single row, hybrid (silicon nitride balls), 15 degree contact angle, ISO tolerance class 4 (P4A), single bearing for universal matching
sources: SKF general catalogue, super-precision angular contact ball bearings, designation 708 CE/HC (skfgeneralcatalogue.net product table, read 2026-11-16 via search index): attainable speeds 130 000 r/min grease, 200 000 r/min oil-air; C 2.34 kN
SKDIN distributor listing of 708 CE/HCP4A (skdin.com/products/productid-708 CE/HCP4A, read 2026-11-16): 8 x 22 x 7 mm, 15 degree, ceramic balls 8 x 3.969 mm, 0.011 kg
708 CE/HCP4A.note: Attainable speed applies to light spring preload and good cooling; oil-in-fuel mist feed is treated as the oil-air case

7004 ACE/HCP4A.type: super-precision angular contact ball bearing, single row, hybrid (HC), 25 degree contact angle (ACE), ISO tolerance class 4 (P4A)
sources: SKF 7004 ACE/HCP4A datasheet as distributed by Loyal (loyal.sg/product/m96832/7004-ace-hcp4a.pdf, read 2026-11-16 via search index): 20 x 42 x 12 mm, ball 6.35 mm, C 7.15 kN, attainable speeds 58 000 r/min grease and 88 000 r/min oil-air
7004 ACE/HCP4A.note: for G6: shaft speed about 44 000 r/min; ball count not given in the source

608.type: deep groove ball bearing, single row, open, pressed steel cage
sources: SKF 608 product listing via RS Components 286-7530 (read 2026-11-27): 8 x 22 x 7 mm, C 3.45 kN, C0 1.37 kN
Schaeffler 608 data sheet via RS Components (docs.rs-online.com/4e0c/A700000009419801.pdf, read 2026-11-27): d1 min 10, D2 max 20, r max 0.3, 0.012 kg
NSK 608 product pages (oss.nsk.com/608mc5-apn.html, read 2026-11-27): 7 balls of 3.969 mm
GMN 608 data sheet (gmnbt.com/assets/pdf/Radial/608.pdf, read 2026-11-27): pitch circle 14.7, inner ring outside diameter 11.8, outer ring inside diameter 17.6
608.note: groove_conformity (groove radius / ball diameter) is not published by the makers; 0.52 is assumed, as for the G6 bearings, and labelled so; r_max is the abutment fillet limit of the data sheet and is used as the ring corner radius (the ring chamfer r_s min equals it); the kernel puts the balls at the mean CN clearance of radial_clearance
